description: This file contains a report implementation for stock ledger in ERPNext, including functions for fetching stock entries, item details, and generating report columns, as well as handling serial numbers and opening balances.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate stock ledger report data based on filters.

methods.name: update_available_serial_nos
methods.description: Updates the serial numbers available for items based on stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the stock ledger report.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database based on filters and items.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves list of item codes based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for items, including UOM conversions if needed.

methods.name: get_sle_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for stock ledger entries based on filters.

methods.name: get_opening_balance
methods.description: Calculates the opening stock balance for the report.

methods.name: get_warehouse_condition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition for warehouse filtering.

methods.name: get_item_group_condition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition for item group filtering.
